title: The Round table in the kitchen
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：round　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 round 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the teacher wrote of ① a round table in the kitchen in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② rounder than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the round ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the roundest table in the kitchen anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too round to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the round ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a round sum of money, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as round as the sum of money they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was round or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something round, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite round; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the round ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, without complaint, she wrote of another round table in the kitchen in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ rounder than anybody had expected. ⑩ The roundest sum of money in the whole classroom, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the round ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 圆形（前置定语 a round table in the kitchen：1972 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件圆形的圆桌）
B. adj. 圆形／整数（比较级 rounder than：文中两处，一处比厨房里的圆桌，一处比预想）
C. adj. 圆形／整数（最高级 the roundest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 圆形（表语 too round to do：母亲觉得它太圆形，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 整数（前置定语 a round sum of money：叔叔把整件事称作一桩整数的一笔整数款项）
F. adj. 整数（同级比较 as round as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一笔整数款项相比）
G. adj. 整数（后置定语 something round：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 整数（受程度副词修饰 quite round：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a round table in the kitchen
the roundest table in the kitchen anybody
The roundest sum of money in

answers.why: round 意为“圆形”，1972 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件圆形的圆桌”，此处作前置定语 a round table in the kitchen。
round 意为“圆形”，此处用比较级 rounder than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
round 意为“圆形”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最圆形的一件，故用最高级 the roundest table in the kitchen。
round 意为“圆形”，母亲认为这件东西“太圆形了，谁也用不上”，too round to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
round 意为“整数”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩整数的一笔整数款项”，此处作前置定语 a round sum of money。
round 意为“整数”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一笔整数款项一样整数”，同级比较用 as round as。
round 意为“整数”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“整数的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something round。
round 意为“整数”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当整数”，quite 修饰原级 round。
round 意为“整数”，1982 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要整数”，故用比较级 rounder than。
round 意为“整数”，母亲 1984 年说的是“整个教室里最整数的那一桩”，故用最高级 the roundest sum of money。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件圆形的圆桌。（a round table in the kitchen）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更圆形。（rounder than …）
母亲觉得它太圆形，谁也用不上。（too round to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩整数的一笔整数款项。（a round sum of money）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一笔整数款项一样整数。（as round as …）
到了 1979 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件整数的东西。（something round）
answers: In 1972 the teacher wrote of a round table in the kitchen in the notebook.
Everybody said it was rounder than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too round to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a round sum of money.
He said nobody would call it as round as the sum of money they had once had.
By 1979 the notebook asked for nothing but something round.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 round 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the teacher wrote of a round table in the kitchen in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the roundest table in the kitchen in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too round to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a round sum of money, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite round, and everybody laughed.
The round ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
